@playwright/mcp@0.0.79 package README (npm pack into reviewer scratchpad, not the task) to confirm browser_run_code_unsafe is a default core tool
evidence:
REAL GATES. scoring.toml lines 1-3: [gates] render = 0.0, constraints = 0.0; [floors] functional = 0.05. score.py:41 gates_passed = all(scores[k] > floor ...); :42 scored_ran = gates_passed and ...; :48 reward = weighted only if gates_passed and floors_passed else 0.0. test.sh:213 runs the gates suite first, :217 score.py after it, :224 scored suite afterwards. Both gate judge.toml use aggregation = "all_pass" with one binary criterion each. (1) Render gate (gates/render/judge.toml:23): 'An incorrect password leaves the visitor signed out with a visible refusal; the correct password for a seeded Recruiter then signs in and shows a usable staff workspace with navigation and readable content ... A static picture or only a health response is insufficient.' This is the auth leg with its positive control (render prompt.md:9 'A valid sign-in immediately after the invalid attempt is the required positive control'). (2) Constraints gate (gates/constraints/judge.toml:47): Recruiter opens a unique job and adds a unique candidate through ordinary UI, then 'In a new independent empty browser context sign in as the Observer ... find that same job and exactly one card for that candidate in Applied ... A static seed response, a no-op success message, a browser-only save or a job-only app does not satisfy the gate.' constraints prompt.md:9 forbids API-only writes and defines independence via browser().newContext(); 'A reload or a second tab of the same context is not independent.' This is the server-backing leg, matching REVIEW_POLICY 'Gates must exclude convincing dead apps' (actual operation plus independent-context readback, not health/static JSON).

IN-DIMENSION GATES IN EVERY SCORED PROMPT. functional/prompt.md:9-13 '## Global browser gate and independent scoring': same Recruiter create + Observer fresh-context readback, 'A static page, a no-op save or a browser-only save fails this check', and ':13 A blank or static shell, an unavailable app or an observed failure of that check gives every binary criterion 0. Once it succeeds, score EACH criterion independently' (all 43 functional criteria are type binary, so this zeroes the dimension). polish/prompt.md:9-12 same check, ':12 A blank or static shell or an observed failure of that check gives binary0 throughout. Otherwise judge each criterion independently' (all 5 polish criteria binary). visual/prompt.md:9-12 same check, ':12 ... gives every criterion its minimum raw Likert score 1, which normalizes to zero' (all 5 visual criteria likert points=5 with anchors 1-5, e.g. visual/judge.toml:24-29), so no partial credit on gate failure. Each in-dimension gate carries the auth leg (sign in as Recruiter and as Observer) and the backing leg (independent context readback). No dimension assigns partial credit on gate failure (the skill's Defect clause).

NO SAME-ORIGIN REQUIREMENT. grep -i 'origin' over task/tests, instruction.md and environment/instructions hits only functional/judge.toml:200 and :236 ('original successful move', 'original places'), neither a gate. No prompt requires assets or requests from localhost only; instruction.md:13 explicitly allows the browser to pull fonts/scripts from a CDN, consistent with the public-network profile. The Internal sheet's older 'cross-origin' wording is superseded by the public row and the skill's Delivery profile.

PUBLIC BASIS FOR GATE LEGS. instruction.md:17 lists the Recruiter and Observer accounts and password; hireops_rules.md section 1 table (Recruiter opens jobs, adds candidates; Observer reads the board) and section 2 (job has title, team, hiring manager, interview places 1-50; candidate has name, email, source; card starts at the bottom of Applied). So every gate leg is publicly required.

TOOL FEASIBILITY. tests/Dockerfile:19 pins @playwright/mcp@0.0.79; its README (npm pack into my scratchpad) lists browser_run_code_unsafe inside the default 'Core automation' block (no --caps opt-in), invoked with page; judge.toml args use --isolated, so page.context().browser() is a real Browser and newContext() is available. The prompt also allows 'a supported separate-context tool'.

GOLDEN SCRIPTED EVIDENCE (raw-evidence-index entries verified: workspace.cjs sha256 773cc339...303c and results/workspace.json sha256 a848d40d...0e354 match the index). workspace.cjs:185-189 types a wrong password, waits for 'do not match', then signs in and sees 'Pipeline board' (render leg). :192-200 opens a job with Team/Hiring manager/Interview places through UI controls and adds candidates through UI (constraints write leg); results 'board: open a job, add candidates ...' passed:true. :365-376 an Observer fresh context reads the board/conversations/activity (passed). The scripted run did NOT read the newly created job's card as the Observer in a fresh context, so the exact gate readback is only partially exercised, and this is scripted Playwright, not the configured claude-code judge.

PROBES. Plausible broken apps the gates catch: localStorage-only board (fails Observer fresh-context readback); pre-seeded static board with a fake 'saved' toast (unique title not found by Observer); password-ignoring sign-in (render refusal leg fails); blank shell (render fails). A conforming alternative that could fail: an app that on a wrong password simply re-shows the empty sign-in form without a message might be judged as lacking a 'visible refusal' (render judge.toml:23); the public brief/rules do not explicitly demand an error message for a wrong password. I judge this a P3 wording note rather than a defect for this row, since staying on the sign-in screen is itself visible and any conventional sign-in shows a refusal, but the owner may soften to 'remains signed out (an error message or the sign-in form still shown)'. Another conforming alternative: an app whose Observer must pick the job from a selector before the board shows; the gate says 'find' through the UI, which accommodates that.
